headline: Profit holds near flat at cycle lows; wide outlook range
summary_short: Deere's quarter ended Nov. 1, 2026 had net income of $1.051B, or $3.89 per share, versus $1.065B a year ago, on revenue of $12.115B, down 2%. FY27 net income is forecast at $4.50B-$5.25B.
summary_long: Net sales and revenues fell 2% to $12,115M; equipment net sales were $10,514M versus $10,579M. Production & Precision Ag sales fell on lower shipments, while Small Ag & Turf and Construction & Forestry sales rose. Fiscal 2026 net income was $4,860M ($17.95 per share) on revenue up 4% to $47,704M. FY27 net income is forecast at $4.50B-$5.25B, including a $0.25B-$0.40B one-time pension settlement charge.
confidence_notes: Period label mismatch: the shard labels this event FY2026 Q3, but the release is Deere's fiscal Q4 FY2026 (quarter ended Nov. 1, 2026); figures come from the release. EPS and net income y/y deltas are computed from the release's stated current and prior values. q/q deltas are not stated and are omitted.

drivers.explanation: Production & Precision Agriculture sales decreased on lower shipment volumes; Small Agriculture & Turf and Construction & Forestry sales increased on higher shipments and price realization.

Production & Precision Ag operating profit fell on lower shipment volumes and sales mix, partly offset by lower production costs and foreign exchange effects. Construction & Forestry profit fell on higher production, SA&G and R&D costs.
Management says North America leads a moderate improvement in large agriculture and results are structurally stronger than at the same point of the last cycle.
